title: ClipRankPayload — the JSON the pod PUTs for kind=clip_rank
description: Numbers only, no ranking and no threshold: one entry per request group, in request order. The cosine runs on the pod inside the same fp16/no_grad block as the towers, so scores and image embeddings come out of ONE forward — the planner's MMR dedup needs the embeddings. The reorder, the relevance floor and the dedup are planner decisions and never cross back. A failure is never a number: a tile with no score has a null score and names its error; a group in which no tile produced anything is status=error.

timings.description: Optional: the pod's own request walls (seconds) and counts known before this payload's PUT. Finite, never negative; a JSON number, never a boolean or a string.

judge_tiles.description: Judge-tile results, one per request judge tile, same order; only with groups == []. ok carries the PUT JPEG's bytes, w, h and whether the origin fetch hit the pod's cache; error names why no tile was written and carries no size.

status.description: error = no tile of this group produced a score or an embed; `error` then carries the first tile's reason. ok otherwise — individual tiles may still have failed, see `errors`.

scores.description: Cosine(image, intent) per image, order mirrors the request group's tiles (image_urls or origin_urls). null exactly when errors[j] names why (unfetchable/undecodable image, or an embed-only group with intent ""). Never a sentinel number.

embeds.description: L2-normalized image embedding per image, same order; null only when errors[j] names a fetch, decode or non_finite failure.

errors.description: Per image, same order: null when the tile scored, otherwise why it has no score. Parallel length (scores/embeds/errors == the request group's tiles) is enforced by the model mirror — JSON Schema cannot express it.

measures.description: Optional, absent unless the pod measured its tiles: per tile, same order, the fetched tile's encoded bytes and decoded width/height, or null for a tile not measured. Parallel length is enforced by the model mirror.

judge_tile_result.description: A judge-tile result never carries an explicit null: a field is present with its value or absent. An ok tile has no error key at all ("error": null included); an error tile has no bytes, w, h or cache key.
